IMPORTANT testing note: DO NOT use input.disabled property alone to verify fieldset[disabled] cascade — HTMLInputElement.disabled only reflects the attribute on the element itself. Must use input.matches(':disabled') which correctly returns true for controls inside fieldset[disabled] per HTML5 spec. Alternative: playwright's .fill() or .type() will time out on truly-disabled inputs which is functional proof.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration is verification-only. All 3 bugs from iteration_11 root-caused and fixed by main agent: (1) Layout.js filter bypass added for item.module==='my_profile' so sidebar link renders without granular permission seed. (2) Each locked tab body wrapped in <fieldset disabled={selfMode}> to leverage HTML5 auto-cascade — no need to wire disabled on every individual control. (3) window.prompt trio replaced with shadcn Dialog + Select/Input/Textarea; PROTECTED_FIELDS_BY_TAB map drives the Select options so user picks from current tab's protected fields. All fixes match the diagnosis in iteration_11's context_for_next_testing_agent.
